title: 第11章 死   死了第12章 白日兵解乘云飞升
slug: 方士开局我给秦始皇画大饼
content_zh:
时间在令人窒息的焦灼中缓缓流逝。
高台之上，冕旒垂下的玉珠微微晃动。
见邹云如同石像般许久不曾动弹，嬴政的耐心也被消磨殆尽。
他微微侧身，低沉的声音打破高台沉寂，“现在，是什么时刻了？”
早已派人盯紧日冕刻度的赵高，立刻条件反射般俯下身子恭敬道，“回禀陛下，当下距离午时，仅余一刻钟！”
“是吗......”
嬴政的目光重新投向法坛，口中发出意义不明的轻叹，说不出是期待还是迷茫。
另一边，仿佛冥冥中感应到帝王的催促，邹云终于有了动静。
正午时分，最为炽烈毒辣的阳光，毫无遮拦的垂射在他脸上。
邹云睁开紧闭许久的双眼，缓缓抬起头，目光投向那片浩瀚无垠的蔚蓝天空，忍不住失神片刻。
‘这如画的大好河山，今日过后，也不知还能否再见到了。’
纵然邹云自认为，已经做足万全准备，也在脑海反复推演过无数遍。
但毕竟事关生死，当这一刻真正降临，他的心底，仍是久久不能平复。
可箭在弦上，已不得不发。
愣神片刻后，终于，他深深吸了一口气，在众人的注视下缓缓起身。
“看，动了。”
“噫，真是让我好等啊。”
“希望等会他，死的足够精彩，没白费我这些时间。”
高台上，众人皆是低声交谈起来。
而邹云则完全摒弃外界干扰，带着一种近乎神圣的庄重，在石公的搀扶下，缓缓躺进那具造型神秘的棺椁中。

那棺椁显然是特制的，并非传统的全封闭样式，而是巧妙将邹云的头颅和小腿以下露在外面，而身躯主体被深色木料包裹。
棺椁通体用鲜艳的朱砂，密密麻麻刻满古老神秘的符文纹饰，在正午阳光下闪烁着诡谲红光。
“这是干什么。”
“自己给自己盖棺材？！！”
不出意料，高台上的看客们又开始起哄，但也有人眉头紧锁，没有发出丁点声音。
而祭坛上，见邹云躺定，侍立一旁的石公面色瞬间变得凝重无比。
他猛地踏前一步，脚下踩起古老而神秘的禹步。
身形随之翻腾扭转，衣袂翻飞间，每一步都精准地踏在无形的风水节点之上，仿佛在丈量天地气机。
与此同时，他口中开始念念有词，那声音低沉、沙哑、急促，带着一种非人的诡异韵律。
喉间滚动着难以辨识的音节，仿佛并非出自凡人之口，而是在与冥冥之中不可名状的鬼神进行沟通。
老江湖就是老江湖。
content_en:
Time passed slowly in suffocating anxiety.
On the high platform, the jade beads hanging down from Mianqi swayed slightly.
Seeing that Zou Yun had not moved for a long time like a stone statue, Ying Zheng's patience was exhausted.
He turned slightly sideways, and his deep voice broke the silence on the high platform, "Now, what time is it?"
Zhao Gao, who had already sent someone to keep an eye on the corona scale, immediately leaned down and said respectfully like a reflex, "Your Majesty, there is only a quarter of an hour left before noon!"
"Really..."
Ying Zheng's eyes returned to the altar, and he let out a sigh of unknown meaning. He couldn't tell whether it was expectation or confusion.
On the other side, as if sensing the emperor's urging, Zou Yun finally made some movement.
At noon, the most blazing and vicious sunlight hit his face without any obstruction.
Zou Yun opened his eyes that had been closed for a long time, slowly raised his head, looked at the vast blue sky, and couldn't help but lose consciousness for a moment.
‘I don’t know if I will ever see this picturesque river and mountains again after today. ’
Even though Zou Yun thought he was fully prepared, he had rehearsed it countless times in his mind.
But after all, it was a matter of life and death. When this moment really came, he still couldn't calm down in his heart for a long time.
But the arrow is on the string and has to be fired.
After being stunned for a moment, he finally took a deep breath and stood up slowly under the gaze of everyone.
"Look, it's moving."
"Oh, it really makes me wait."
"I hope he will die wonderfully enough later and not waste my time."
On the high platform, everyone was talking in low voices.
Zou Yun, on the other hand, completely abandoned external interference, and with an almost divine solemnity, he slowly lay down in the mysteriously shaped coffin with the support of Shi Gong.
The coffin was obviously specially made. It was not the traditional fully enclosed style. Instead, Zou Yun's head and lower legs were cleverly exposed, while the main body was wrapped in dark wood.
The entire body of the coffin is made of bright cinnabar, densely engraved with ancient and mysterious runes and patterns, and glows with an eerie red light in the midday sun.
"What is this for?"
"Build your own coffin?!!"
As expected, the spectators on the high platform began to boo again, but some frowned and did not make a sound.
On the altar, when Zou Yun was seen lying down, the expression of Shi Gong standing beside him instantly became extremely solemn.
He took a step forward suddenly, stepping on the ancient and mysterious Yu steps.
His body was tumbling and twisting, his clothes were flying, and every step he took was precisely on the invisible Feng Shui node, as if he was measuring the energy of the heaven and earth.
At the same time, he began to mutter words. The voice was low, hoarse, and rapid, with an inhuman and strange rhythm.
The indecipherable syllables rolled in the throat, as if they were not spoken by mortals, but were communicating with indescribable ghosts and gods in the underworld.
Laojianghu is Laojianghu.
